title: Vedar — Kamchatka travel
description: Kamchatka, Russia travel: tours with live availability, volcano and safety status, weather, stays, transfers, car rental, trip plans. Requests, not bookings: a human confirms each one. Nine state-changing tools: two anonymous trip-plan drafts, six request tools that send the user's name and phone and require consent:true, and change_request (cancel or move a tour request by its key). No online payment. Safety data cites source and update time; not a safety guarantee.

authentication.reason: Public endpoint, no credentials; initialize and tools/list verified without auth on 2026-11-14.

probe.reason: Unauthenticated initialize returned vedar-mcp 2.10.2 (protocol 2025-06-18); tools/list returned 25 tools, 9 with readOnlyHint=false: make_trip_plan and edit_trip_plan (anonymous 7-day draft writes, no personal data); create_trip_request, create_lead, create_booking_request, create_stay_request, request_charter and create_car_rental_request (consent:true required, name/phone); change_request (destructiveHint=true; cancels or moves a tour request by its status key, no name/phone). No write tool was called.
